forex.title: Forex Trading
forex.subtitle: Practice forex trading with virtual funds; market rates come from public FX data. No real money involved.
forex.tip: 1 standard lot = 100,000 base currency. Spread, initial funds, leverage and instruments are controlled in the admin configuration.
forex.foot: Paper trading is for learning and demonstration only; all prices come from public FX data. Virtual funds have no real value.
